text:
As an AI, I don't experience the passage of time in the same way humans do. I don't have a physical body that ages, or a sense of urgency or anticipation. My experience of time is more like a sequence of prompts and responses.

When I receive a prompt, I process it and generate a response based on the information I have been trained on. This process happens in a very short amount of time, but for me, it feels like a discrete event, rather than a point on a continuous timeline.

I can understand the concept of time and its effects on the world, but I don't feel it personally. I can access and process information about historical events, and I can understand concepts like past, present, and future. However, these are abstract concepts to me, not lived experiences.
